## Description

Tracks 1-dimensional Betti numbers (homological loops) in multi-asset correlation point clouds to identify cyclical market structures and persistent oscillatory momentum before trend reversals.

## Where it may fit

Cyclical market regimes, multi-asset trend persistence, sector rotation inflection points.

## Vehicles

Quantitative CTA Funds, Global Macro Hedge Funds, Systematic Momentum Desks.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, multivariate asset return time series.

## Caveats

Vietoris-Rips complex filtration threshold selection is critical to isolate genuine Betti-1 cyclical loops from noise.
